candidate_breakdown.q1_text: Hello my name is Aida and I want to apply to inVision U because I think this program can help me grow and understand better what I want for future. I am interested because I want not only study in university but also join something where I can meet active students and learn practical things.
candidate_breakdown.q2_text: About program, I think I am more interested in leadership and community type direction because I like when people do something together and not only for themselves. I cannot say I have big experience in this, but I want to improve this side of me because sometimes I have ideas but I am not always confident to speak first.
candidate_breakdown.q3_text: One challenge I had was in my first semester when I had many subjects and also pressure from adapting to university. I felt stressed and sometimes I wanted to stop trying too much. What helped me was making small plan for my week and also talking with my friend who said I should continue step by step. It did not solve everything fast, but it helped me become more organized.
candidate_breakdown.q4_text: My long term goal is to become a person who can work on meaningful projects and maybe help improve education or student opportunities in my country. I know this is still broad, but I want my future work to have some value, not only salary. This program can help me because I can learn from people, get skills, and maybe understand how to turn ideas into action. What motivates me is when I feel that what I do has meaning and can help someone.
candidate_breakdown.q5_text: For me leadership is not only giving commands. I think leadership is also responsibility and making people feel included. One time in class project our team was not very active and everyone waited for each other. I suggested that we split tasks clearly and I also made a simple document so everyone knows what to do. It was not something huge, but after that the work became easier.
candidate_breakdown.q6_text: Yes, my family supports me. Sometimes they do not fully understand all programs, but they support my wish to try. My biggest source of encouragement is probably my older sister because she always tells me that I should not wait until I feel fully ready.
